dialog: There must be something even I can do.
Even I could probably handle this one.
I'm not a big fan of violence/ but...
Flee now/ and I'll let you go.
You picked the wrong god to mess with.
You're the one who started this/ understand?
You'll get what you deserve.
That's odd. You seem quite welcoming of misfortune/ don't you?
I'm not a very merciful god. I can't just smile and forgive.
I do hope you were prepared for this.
You're standing on MY path.
Not today. This is to protect humans.
You're not laying a hand on the humans.
Well/ SOMEONE has to do it!
I'll show you the power of a misfortune god.
Now that I'm here/ your luck has run out.
If you want to keep your good fortune/ then apologize nicely.
Maybe a little enthusiasm is good for me once in a while.
At this point/ I'll fight as much as I need to.
If I gave up here/ I'd damage my reputation as a misfortune god.
I think I still have a little more misfortune to squeeze out.
That's it. Time to drown you in misfortune.
I'll circle around them.
It's important to always do one's best/ isn't it?
You want to experience misfortune too/ do you?
I'm coming through!
I warned you.
I think I might have a bit too much misfortune on my hands.
Have you realized how unlucky you were to meet me?
There's no escape from this swarm of misfortune.
I'm not even aiming/ here.
Misfortune will befall you.
I've been keeping this misfortune just for you...
Now go.
I'll show you what lies past misfortune...
You will end here.
Sometimes/ misfortune can stab like thorns.
Just like this/ in fact.
This misfortune will hollow out your flesh.
Drown in pain and suffering.
Not only will you taste the pain...
You'll feel the weight of the misfortune you invited upon yourself.
It's going to hurt if this curse hits you.
Clad in misfortune/ the puppet floats away...
Is this a good time to spin my heart out?
This one will sting badly if you touch it.
There's no point forcing myself.
I can't chase them too far.
I guess waiting and watching is all I can do right now...
Are you truly that scared of misfortune?
My misfortune can't reach quite that far.
That might have been all my fault...
It should be my job to shield others/ not the other way around...
Follow-up attacks are a fundamental form of misfortune.
Get back or the misfortune will affect you!
Misfortune god/ coming through.
I'm alright. I'm used to this.
I won't abandon a friend.
I will shoulder your misfortune.
I'll follow your instructions.
You can decide how we attack.
I can't let you do all the work.
Shall I lend you a hand?
I can't afford to lose here.
Take care not to come in contact with the misfortune.
Be careful this doesn't hit you.
I can fight at the front too.
I have free rein to wield my misfortune now.
This should let me use my misfortune very effectively.
Now my misfortune has even doomed Nitori...
You do tend to cut corners sometimes/ Nitori.
Just keep barreling forward/ Nitori.
Why don't I protect you once in a while?
I won't let you hurt Nitori.
Don't get distracted/ Nitori.
There's a term for this/ isn't there? An all-out barrage?
Stay calm and take aim.
I'll give you a hand/ Nitori.
I can't let you do all the work/ Nitori.
Take care not to touch the misfortune/ Nitori.
Even misfortune is easily wielded when I'm with Nitori.
Let's make this misfortune explode/ Nitori.
I can't just rely on Nitori all the time.
Now my misfortune has even doomed Medicine...
They're still going strong/ you know/ Medicine.
I'll give you some backup/ Medicine.
Stay focused/ Medicine.
Don't rush things/ Medicine.
Be careful not to let out too much poison/ okay?
Take care not to touch the misfortune/ Medicine.
I'll give you a hand/ Medicine.
Stay calm and take aim.
Let me join you/ Medicine.
Even misfortune is easily wielded when I'm with Medicine.
You're not alone/ Medicine.
Medicine/ it's time to combine your poison with my misfortune.
I hope I didn't stray too far from my misfortune.
I can't afford to get hit right now.
I'll do what I need to.
Challenging us? With that?
I AM still a god/ you know.
If you fear misfortune/ then I recommend running.
It'll take more than that. I'm not THAT weak.
I can't take another one of those hits...
I... I can't lose here!
If I go down/ my misfortune will...
S-Such strength!
This doesn't bode well...
They're aiming for me?!
Looks like we won't be able to talk this out.
I see you're not very attached to your life.
Ow/ that hurt...
I let one through...
I have to keep it together...
Eeeek!
I managed to hold out...
Not today. This is to protect humans.
I never thought I'd get through this unscathed...
Oh/ I didn't realize you WANTED misfortune.
They missed! Wait/ was it on purpose?
You're so easy to read.
Haven't you had enough? This isn't doing you any good.
If you thought I wasn't used to this/ then you've underestimated me.
I don't think I'll ever enjoy this thrill.
I can dodge these bullets/ but it doesn't exactly bode well for me.
Hey! You'll get my clothes dirty.
Even I can handle this much.
Round and round I go~
That went pretty well.
That was close.
That isn't going to work.
The power of my misfortune will let none come close.
This is surprisingly fun.
Hah!
If you just sit there/ the misfortune will catch you.
Even I wouldn't like an opportunity like this get away.
I knew I was doomed...
Hmm. I see I wasn't suited for this...
I'm sorry. I need to withdraw early.
They were a step ahead. I'm going to leave before my misfortune gets everywhere.
So this is part of investigating incidents...
For the humans' sake/ I'll need to take you down.
My misfortune will bring an end to your ambitions.
After this is all resolved/ I'll take some spring home with me.
I don't get many chances to have danmaku battles. Allow me to enjoy this.
Don't resent me if your luck takes a turn for the worse.
Could you maybe restrain yourself a little?
Is the ceremony exciting enough for you now?
Ugh/ these filthy fireworks...
I didn't come out here just to lose...
Give up or I'll hit you with bad luck.
Look/ would you please just settle down?
How can a child not be afraid of bad luck?
Are none of you afraid of misfortune?
Give me just a moment/ Utsuho. I'll rid you of that misfortune.
What ominous misfortune... It'll engulf everything if left unchecked.
It takes all sorts to make a festival/ I suppose.
You act like you're not even aware you're a celestial.
All you're doing is creating misfortune for pranks.
You understand nothing about what this bazaar means/ do you...
Let's talk first/ alright?
You certainly don't seem like a stranger.
The things you're all doing are wrong.
I can't allow anymore misfortune to be created...
You're like one big clump of misfortune.
You'll need more than a bit of accumulated misfortune to get through us.
The things you're all doing are wrong.
Let me through/ or else...
What you're doing is far too dangerous.
All you're doing is creating misfortune for pranks.
I don't want to fight/ but...
Your actions are creating misfortune in Gensokyo.
I'm taking back all the dreams here—for Gensokyo.
We've both spent ourselves in this battle... So let us end it.
Your actions are creating misfortune in dreams.
I'm taking back the world of dreams—for Makura.
Let's give this everything we possibly can. Then our battle will end.
